result3 = angle3.to_string(precision=1)

from astropy.coordinates.angle import Angle

# Test case: fields=1 with values that should not round up

probe('fields1_285d29m41_76s', result1)

# Test case: fields=1 with seconds rounding but minutes not carrying
angle2 = Angle('285d29m59.9s')
result2 = angle2.to_string(fields=1)
probe('fields1_285d29m59_9s', result2)

# Test case: fields=1 where minutes should round up to degrees
angle3 = Angle('285d30m')
result3 = angle3.to_string(fields=1)
probe('fields1_285d30m', result3)
